candidates.suggested_text_hook: why do you have my clip?

candidates.why_people_may_comment: Comments can confess the weird item their partner carries.

top_pick: The Hair Clip In His Pocket
engagement_rationale: One object, one repeated couple habit, one affectionate accusation. The hook is readable in under three seconds and the comment bait is naturally specific.
